meta.title: Project anchor
meta.description: Ties sessions to projects: the first message of a new session is matched to a project automatically and that project's card (period, settled conventions, no-go zones, resume point) is injected as context; conclusions land in a cross-session searchable index. Auto-attach appends one row to _台账/归属.jsonl, so the workspace must be writable. The injection-detail switch lasts for the current run only.
